quarterly_data.quarter: Prysmian press release: Prysmian completes Atkore acquisition to accelerate growth (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Acquisition completed (release): Prysmian completed the acquisition of Atkore, a U.S.-based provider of electrical infrastructure solutions (conduits, cable management systems and metal framing), under the merger agreement of August 2, 2026; Atkore is now a wholly owned subsidiary, its shares no longer trade on the New York Stock Exchange, and it will be fully consolidated from November 2026. The combined business has more than 60 manufacturing and distribution sites across the United States, and Prysmian says it will serve a greater share of customers' needs in data centers, utilities and commercial and industrial infrastructure. Prysmian expects approximately $150 million of annual run-rate pretax synergies within three years of closing.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 60 U.S. manufacturing and distribution sites; consolidated from November 2026; approximately $150 million run-rate synergies within three years
